# Review - PR 299 @ 6d417606d5b2d17a61114caa45841bf7559e230b

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: `eca570e62416897f03aee5355a3f49e97e510e24` (github/main). Large construction packet, +2930/-9 against merge base `55a94e7850c04dc9979ce840e889a07c87333f29` on `main`: four new Lean modules plus the final proof, two Magic Square visibility/documentation changes, one audit note and two blueprint chapters, discharging the single `sorry` of `exists_spcc_value_one`.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (code; minor) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/Completeness/HonestStrategy/MeasurementFamily.lean:440` - `pauliBasisMeasurement_effect_transpose` is an empty pass-through of `pauliProj_transpose` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Pauli.lean:416` on main); its whole proof is `exact pauliProj_transpose W h`, and its `P` is an undeclared auto-implicit (`#check` prints `∀ {P : AdmissibleParams} (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P), ...`), which also pins a general statement to `PauliRegister P`. Fix: delete the declaration and pass `pauliProj_transpose W` at line 469 (it is definitionally the required `∀ a, (M.effect a)ᵀ = M.effect a`); if it is kept, bind `(P : AdmissibleParams)` explicitly. Rules cited: `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md:391` ("Do not add an empty pass-through abbreviation merely to introduce a second public name") and `AGENTS.md:396` ("Do not rely on auto-implicit variables"). This is the same alias pattern that round-1 finding F1 of this PR required removed.
- [ ] F2 (code; minor) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/Completeness/HonestStrategy/MeasurementFamily.lean:31` - the `variable {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]` block is dead in this module: no declaration in the file mentions `K` or a bare `ι` (every `ι` occurrence is the named argument `ιB := ZMod 2`/`ιB := W`). Fix: delete lines 31-32.

## Review

Scope reviewed: the full main-relative diff, every changed file read in full. Base is `main`, so no stacked-base handling was needed. The published head equals the worktree HEAD.

Statement integrity. `exists_spcc_value_one` is the pre-existing public statement from main with the `sorry` replaced by a proof; its signature is byte-identical and I re-checked it against the paper at `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1232-1234` ("The Pauli basis test ... has a value-$1$ SPCC strategy") - paper assumptions: an admissible tuple; Lean assumptions: `P : AdmissibleParams` only; paper conclusion and Lean conclusion: existence of an SPCC strategy of value one. No bridge, residual, package, producer, witness or obligation input was added, and no anti-pattern A1-A6 applies: the win predicate `pauliWinPredicate`, the sampler `pauliQuestionDistribution`, the game and the value are all untouched by this diff, so the value-one claim cannot be trivialised from inside the packet. The one deliberate divergence - retaining the Pauli trace measurements on the `(Pair,W)` questions when the phase bit is nonzero, where the source makes them trivial - changes only the existential witness, is documented in the blueprint note and in the audit, and does not alter any hypothesis or conclusion.

Proof integrity, verified directly. `rg` over all five changed Lean files at this head finds no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide`. On the built worktree I ran `lake env lean` on a probe importing `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Completeness`: `#print axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_spcc_value_one` and `#print axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestStrategy_isSPCC` both return exactly `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. Exact-head CI is green: `local-ci/summary` "all gating steps passed (281s)", with build, proof-debt, proof-evasion, file-length, blueprint-render, blueprint-sync and paper-gaps all success.

Reuse and duplication. I grepped github/main for each new public name (`pauliProj_nonneg`, `pauliProj_conjTranspose`, `pauliProj_isProj`, `tauObservable_transpose`, `unitMeasurement`, `deterministicMeasurement`, `leftPlaced_commute`, `postprocess_effect_commute`, `pauliBasisMeasurement`, `restrictToAxisLine`, `pauliTraceBit`, `placedPauliMeasurement`, `HonestIndex`, `pauliAnswerOfMs`): none collides with an existing declaration. `pauliProj_nonneg` and `pauliProj_conjTranspose` are order- and Hermitian-form conversions of `posSemidef_pauliProj`, not renames, and are load-bearing for `Measurement.ofSumEqOne` and `pauliProj_isProj`; I do not object to them. Only the case in F1 is a pure alias. Paper locators in the new docstrings check out against the mirror: the strategy specification does begin at line 1237 and `A`/`B` are defined at 1281-1286, both inside the ranges now cited.

Prior findings. Round-1 F1 and F2 were already resolved before this head. All nine round-2 findings are resolved at this head: the honest-strategy locator is now `1237-1360` and the trace measurements cite `1277-1286`; the six formerly undocumented public effect and symmetry lemmas carry docstrings; the audit is renamed to the underscore form and carries the required YAML front matter; the blueprint proof sketch now keeps `E^{(Pair,X)}=A_a` and `E^{(Pair,Z)}=B_a` for nonzero phase so the sketch matches the formal witness, with an explicit note on the divergence; `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex` now links `restrictToAxisLine` and `evalCoefficient_restrictToAxisLine_lowDegreeEncoding` with prose describing the degree-`d` axis-line form; the `Assembly` module is renamed `HonestStrategy/MeasurementFamily.lean` with mathematical headings (the only surviving "Assembly" string is a historical blob-manifest row in the audit, which is a factual provenance record); the "wrong constructor" and "fibre-collapse" wording is gone, replaced by "answers of an inadmissible form", "answer-format rejection clause" and "the composition identity for successive coarse-grainings"; and the five Magic Square lemmas made public carry "Formalization-only auxiliary ..." docstrings.

Prose lane. The new proof-level `\leanok` on `lem:pauli-completeness` is valid: the Lean proof is `sorry`-free with a clean axiom closure. The added `\uses{lem:low-degree-encoding-line-restriction}` matches the actual dependency on the axis-line restriction, and the two new `\lean{...}` names in `ch14` correspond to declarations that are proved, not stated. The extended `ch14` sentence ("this degree-$d$ list has the same coefficient-list evaluation $g_h(u)$ at every $u\in\ell$") is exactly what `evalCoefficient_restrictToAxisLine_lowDegreeEncoding` proves, under the same axis-parallel hypothesis. I found no Lean jargon in the new blueprint prose and no claim of proof for anything unproved.

Not checked: I did not run a full `lake build` or re-render the blueprint (I relied on the green exact-head CI for those), I did not re-derive the 852-line rejection case analysis line by line beyond reading it and confirming its axiom closure, and I did not audit declarations outside the diff.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=APPROVED)
